Succeed,Ⓒv. i.Ⓓ(Of things) nizpad 1 A, saM-pad, saPalIBU 1 P; Pal 1 P; siD c. (sADayati), jayaM Ap 5 P, vijayin a. BU (of persons); siD 4 P (of both); ‘be s(ucced)ed in all his attempts’ sarve tasya prayatnA nizpannAH-saPalA baBUvuH &c.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹEx. by Go q. v. with (anaMtaraM with abl.) paScAt (with gen.); anu pr.; ‘s(ucceed)ing his father as sovereign of the North Kosala’ pituranaMtaramuttarakoSalAnsamaDi-gamya (R. ix. 1); ‘s(ucceed) to the throne’ rAjapadaM-siMhAsanaM-Aruh 1 P, rAjapadaM Ap 5 P, rAjapadaBAg BU; ‘s(ucced)ed his brother’ BrAtuH paScAt rAjyamavApaH ‘s(ucced)ed the General’ senApateH paScAt tatpadamavApa, (lit.) senApatimanvagacCat; See Follow; ‘joy s(ucced)ed by fear’ BayottaraH harzaH.
Ⓝ[Succeed]ing,Ⓒa.Ⓓpara, uttara, AgAmin, anuyAyin-gAmin; ‘s(ucceeding) generations’ putrapOtrAdayaH, uttara-kAlInA janAH.
ⓃSuccess,Ⓒs.ⒹsidDi f., sAPalyaM, arTa-sADya-sidDiH, kftArTatA, jayaH, saMpad f., SrIH, udayaH.
Ⓝ[Success]ful,Ⓒa.Ⓓkftin, kftArTa, sidDArTa, vijayin, caritArTa, kfta-kftya, prApta-pUrRa-labDa-kAma, saMpannamanoraTa.
Ⓑ
 2 (Of things) sidDa, saPala, nizpanna, Palavat.
Ⓝ[Success]fully,Ⓒadv.ⒹsaPalaM, avfTA, amoGaM, sidDyA.
Ⓝ[Success]ion,Ⓒs.Ⓓanu-, kramaH, paraMparA, Anu-pUrvyaM, paryAyaH, anvayaH, SreRI; See Order; ‘in s(uccession)’ anukramaM-krameRa, yaTAkramaM, anu-pUrvaSaH, niraMtarAsvaMtaravAtavfzwizu (K. v. 25) ‘coming in s(uccession)’.
Ⓑ
 2 SreRI, Avali-lI f., mAlA; See Series.
Ⓑ
 3 uttarADikAraH-ritA, dayADikAraH.
Ⓝ[Success]ive,Ⓒa.ⒹkramabadDa, Anukramika (kI f.), yaTAkrama, anu-pUrva, paraMparA or krama-Agata or AyAta, kramAnu-sArin.
Ⓑ
 2 niraMtara, satata, avirata.
Ⓝ[Success]ively,Ⓒadv.ⒹkramaSaH, krameRa, anukramaSaH, anupUrvaSaH, AnupUrvyeRa^1, yaTAkramaM.
Ⓝ[Success]or,Ⓒs.ⒹpratyanaMtaraH, uttarADikArin m., anaMtarAgAmI.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20161010.
